name: prisma
description: Connect Prisma to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Prisma MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Prisma to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with postgres databases, backups and Compute apps using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Prisma workspace.
Find anything in Prisma that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review postgres databases, backups and Compute apps in Prisma.
